# Healthcare International Group (HCIG)

> Healthcare International Group (HCIG) is built to manage the full patient journey from first medical contact to advanced treatment and international…

HCIG is the Official Partner of Global Healthcare Accreditation (GHA) and the German Medical Wellness Association (DMWV) in Egypt. 40+ Years of Experience. 600K+ Patients Served. 350+ Medical Professionals. 135+ On-Site Clinics Across Egypt. Contact: partner@healthcareig.com
